submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create one opaque full-bleed native game-map detail square. Image1 gives EXACT framing, scale, geometry and object footprints forr09_c10/r04_c02. The left and top neighboring reference band(s) each use first115 pixels as strict native context. Keep those source grooves, bevels, contours, scale and shadow endpoints exact. The following115 pixels (indices115..229) are guide-only halo softly transitioned into regional context; complete them coherently, without reproducing a compositing band as artwork. At a shared corner, the top/north strict source takes precedence. Never turn guide tone differences, straight compositing bounds, or softened reference edges into walls, steps, extra paving blocks, foliage edges, new shadows, or broken grooves. Reconstruct only the soft interior into crisp real hand-painted detail at matching scale. Do not move, crop, rotate, enlarge or recompose anything. Image2 is the user-confirmed PRIMARY painting/material reference: bright, clean, rounded, full-bodied Daoist chibi fantasy, readable smooth bevels and restrained low-contrast painterly surfaces. Copy no UI, words, floral ornaments, characters, lighting or objects from Image2. Inventory is determined only by Image1: retain only its existing materials, objects, foliage and shadows. A stone-only target must remain stone only. No added plants, flowers, gray paving blocks, walls, objects, stains or cast shadows. Quiet clean stone: no grit, cracks, veins, spotted noise, exaggerated brush patches, blur or sharpening halos. Keep existing leaves rounded and clean. No new buildings, circles, stairs, medallions, symbols, characters, frames, labels or watermark. Return only the single native1254-square detail image at highest available fidelity.
Actual crop inventory: existing green shrub at left, orange planter/rim across center-left, ivory stone riverwall/railing and its square pier at center-right/bottom, cool-gray bridge surface cropped at top-right, a clipped dark post base at upper-left, and blue water with the existing cyan ripples at right/bottom. These existing gray/ivory stone structures and their block joints MUST remain, not be removed under the no-new-wall/gray-block rule. Preserve the exact bend of the wall, pier depth, orange rim, joint positions and all waterline contours. Keep existing soft material highlights, but add no cracks, chips, dark stains or decorative stone lines. Preserve ONLY the existing ripples, water color, plant footprint and contact shadows. No new fish, pads, flowers, symbols, text, extra wall section or new plant. The guide-only soft bands may not become dark rectangles or broken rail corners. Green rosettes are rounded leaves, never colored blossoms.
